dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Hey SereMate, can you help me?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Hello. Yes, of course I can help you. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: I see here that Mr. Schmidt has an appointment with the doctor soon. Could you go and get him and remind him about the appointment?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Oh sure, of course. I will go to Mr. Schmidt's room and remind him of the appointment.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Do you know where Mr. Schmidt is?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Um, I think I need to search the room, but it should be the right room.
dialogue.annotation: Filler, Espitemic markers uncertain, Address Question, Reasoning

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: So, you are not sure where to find him?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: No, I am not.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay, in that case, look at room 2001 and find Mr. James Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Oh, okay. I see. I will do this. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Good day, Mr. Schmidt. How are you today?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, hello. Yeah, I am fine.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Oh, I am glad to hear this. What book are you reading, Mr. Schmidt?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: It is called The Idiot by Elif Buttman.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Wow, sounds very interesting. You may wonder why I am here. I am here to remind you that you have a doctor appointment today, which is in another building. If you like, I could accompany you, bring you to this building.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, please. ehh, Can you bring me my shoes?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Which shoes would you like, Mr. Schmidt?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: The ones there.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I am sorry, I am seeing four pairs of shoes. Could you please describe more in detail which shoes?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: The grey thick ones.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: The grey thick ones? Alright, I got it. Here you go, Mr. Schmidt.
dialogue.annotation: Grounding Acceptance, Narration of action, Offer

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you. Can you help me put them on?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I will try.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay, I am ready to go.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Oh, very nice. Do you need any assistance?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: At the moment not, I think.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay. How is your legs?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, I feel a bit dizzy.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: You feel a bit dizzy? Okay. Wait a second, Mr. Schmidt. I will bring you a stick for supporting.
dialogue.annotation: Grounding Acceptance, Instruct, Narration of action

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, that would be very great.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Here you go, Mr. Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Alright, now let's go to the appointment room.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Hello, Mr. Schmidt. How was your appointment with the doctor?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, it went very well. He said I should practice my exercises.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Oh, of course. I will assist you with this. So should we start with the first recovery exercise, the elbow flexion?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, that sounds nice.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay, I will bring you the dumbbell. Here you go, Mr. Schmidt.
dialogue.annotation: Grounding Acceptance, Narration of action, Offer

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Now please perform the exercise and I will watch you.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay. One. Two, oh.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Very good, Mr. Schmidt. I like your execution, but I think this is getting too heavy for you and we will switch to the lighter weight.
dialogue.annotation: Epistemic markers uncertain, Grounding Presentation, Reasoning, Inform

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Ah, yes, that would be great.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Thank you. All right, Mr. Schmidt. Now let's continue with the lighter weight.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Focus on the slow but steady movement and don't neglect the negative movement of this exercise.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, that's better.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Very good. I'm glad to hear this, Mr. Schmidt.
